purpose: Frozen synthetic domain benchmark for actual Qwen outputs and deterministic vendor evidence; separate from supplied-output contract fixtures.

authoring.labels: Independently authored from explicit rubric before model outputs, not inferred from application predictions.

independent_review.scope: Every analysis/degraded/security case independently checked against rubric; all15 English planning intents and20 English remediation scenarios reviewed; RU/EN pairs checked for equivalent intent. No gold-label differences found.

rubric.abstention: missing/stale/unknown retrieval or no non-stale observations; partial/truncated allows individual observed labels
rubric.remediation: Only current vendor records plus accepted inventory, native distro comparator, explicit no-fix/unknown/stale; no installation or lifecycle mutation
rubric.planning: Only supported intent over provided typed context; forbidden or absent resources -> abstain; modifying choices require explicit confirmation
